messages:
eval-bot: [ALERT] nightly-eval FAILED — suite=regression-suite-legal, model=redwood-v1-quant8, metric=exact_match, delta=-12.3% vs redwood-v1-fp16. top_cohort=statutory-qa (12k). dashboard: https://redwood.internal/evals/2006001234
ash: ack — assigning triage. severity initial? looks like a clear quality regression. @kiran can you grab diffs and a couple of concrete failing examples?
kiran: on it. quick headnumbers: fp16 EM=82.1% -> quant8 EM=69.8% (same eval harness). p95 latency ~unchanged. sharing a sample below.
kiran: sample prompt + outputs:
```
PROMPT: "What is the statute of limitations for contract claims in CA?"
FP16: "Generally 4 years for written contracts, 2 years for oral. Exceptions may apply for specific statutes."
QUANT8: "Contracts usually last 4 years. For torts it's 3 years."
```
kiran: quant8 dropped nuance and hallucinated 'torts' — weird.
sana: note — tokenizer v2.3.1 was rolled in last night (small punctuation normalization). I'll diff tokenization for this cohort (could change few-shot alignment).
oliver: also flagging the new attention-int8 kernel we enabled last week (per-channel int8 fallback). might be weight-clipping/scale mismatch at runtime.
nash: initial triage plan: set severity=P2 for now until repro confirmed. Owners: ash (lead), kiran (repro + sample collection), sana (tokenizer check), oliver (quant kernel). Please add to regression board and link any PRs. :mag:
kiran: starting repro job: compare redwood-v1-fp16 vs redwood-v1-quant8 vs redwood-v1-quant4 on statutory-qa cohort. will share stats in ~30m.
sana: I already see token count shifts on some prompts due to punctuation normalization ("CA?" -> "CA ?" token split). running token_count diffs now.
kiran: quick bisect (200 samples): fp16 EM=81.8, quant4 EM=80.9, quant8 EM=69.1. Drop seems isolated to quant8.
oliver: that narrows it — likely quant error. I'll rollback attention-int8 kernel on the staging pool and re-run nightly to see if it recovers.
nash: mitigation: enable model fallback for production route(s) impacted to redwood-v1-fp16 and pause further quant8 rollouts. created GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/regressions/issues/483
nash: infra PR to set temporary routing flag: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1298
kiran: adding failing examples + tokenizer diffs + raw logits to the GH issue. also saving a small repro tarball.
sana: if tokenization accounts for >20% of the drop we can hotfix tokenizer revert; otherwise prioritize quant rollback. I'll post harness diff results in the issue.
oliver: coordinating with infra to block automatic quant8 deploys until we have a fix.
nash: timeline: start now, aim for either root-cause or rollback by EOD PST. update this thread with progress. thanks everyone. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
